study type: Prospective observational study and randomized controlled trial
exposure: tactile stimulation during neonatal transition and resuscitation
Gestational age at birth (preterm vs. term)
cohort: Preterm and term neonates born by Cesarean delivery
finding: Tactile stimulation was applied differently in preterm and term infants during neonatal transition, with preterm infants showing a significant increase in SpO2 after stimulation.
mod_finding: This study analyzed tactile stimulation during neonatal transition and resuscitation in preterm and term neonates born by Cesarean delivery.
